description: The ocean.config.json shape that declares deployment-mode override groups: the base lifecycle task map every repo already carries, plus a named-group overlay array where each group partially overrides tasks and inherits the rest from the base map. Feature #65, Unit: Core CLI, Interface: Lifecycle Command.

entities.name: LifecycleTaskMap
entities.description: The base tasks map on a repo config: lifecycle-op name -> shell command template. The existing RepoConfig.tasks. Group overlays are validated and resolved against the task names this map declares.

entities.name: OverrideGroup
entities.description: One named deployment-mode override entry in a repo config's `overrides` array. Carries a group name and a partial task overlay declaring only the tasks that differ from the base LifecycleTaskMap; omitted tasks inherit the base command. Requirements #145, #146, #147, #148, #150.

fields.name: group
fields.description: The group's selector name (e.g. "desktop"). Must be unique across the array (#146) and non-empty (#147). Matched against the --group flag value at op time; an unmatched --group is a hard error (#152).

fields.name: tasks
fields.description: The partial overlay: a subset of lifecycle-op names, each mapped to this group's command template. Every overlay key must name a task present in the base LifecycleTaskMap (#148). Overlaid task names not listed here fall back to the base command (#150).

entities.name: TaskOverlay
entities.description: A group's partial task map: lifecycle-op name -> this group's command template. Same field vocabulary as LifecycleTaskMap but every field optional, since a group declares only what it overrides. Command templates carry the same {{env:*}}/{{var:*}}/{{ocean:*}}/{{repo:*}} tokens as base tasks (#154).

entities.name: RepoConfigOverrides
entities.description: The additive extension to the existing RepoConfig (ocean.config.json): an `overrides` array of OverrideGroup entries alongside the existing base `tasks` map. Additive and backward-compatible — a config with no `overrides` key behaves exactly as before (base mode only). Requirement #145.

fields.name: tasks
fields.description: The existing base task map (unchanged; referenced here for context, not redefined).

fields.name: overrides
fields.description: The deployment-mode override groups. Absent or empty means base mode only. Parsed and validated on config load: duplicate names (#146), empty names (#147), and overlays of unknown base tasks (#148) are validation errors.
